A '''duelling sword''' was a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] specifically designed for dueling.<ref name="RPG" /> Both [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Imal Valesovich]] and [[High Lord]] [[Jaris Affric]] employed the services of [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] to acquire ancient duelling swords.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
